body.name: Exact deletion and action-regret components
body.construction:
For \(m\in\mathcal M_n\), define
\[
D_{n,m}(\beta)=d_{T_n^{\mathrm{full}}}(\beta)
-\left(\frac Nn\right)^2E_{S_m}d_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(\beta)
\]
and, for every pilot-measurable action \(\delta_m\), define
\[
L_{n,m}(\delta_m,\beta)=\left(\frac Nn\right)^2E\!\left[
V_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(\delta_m,\beta)
-V_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}
\{G_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(\beta),\beta\}\right].
\]
